description: Automatic observability stack for Granian with OpenTelemetry: instead of exposing /metrics, all traces, metrics, and logs are collected automatically through OTEL and sent to Grafana LGTM (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Prometheus), with optional S3 persistence and an optimized Docker setup.

spec.expr: sum by(path) (http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job="$service_name", http_status_code=~"5.*", path!="/metrics"}) / sum by(path) (http_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job="$service_name", path!="/metrics"})

spec.description: Traces containing a span emitted by the service
spec.title: Trace Logs

spec.expr: sum by(method, route, graph_id) (http_request_latency_seconds_sum{job="$service_name", tenant="$tenant_id", graph_id="$graph_id"}) / (sum by(method, route, graph_id) (http_request_latency_seconds_count{job="$service_name", tenant="$tenant_id", graph_id="$graph_id"}))

sum by(method, route, graph_id) (http_request_latency_seconds_sum{job="$service_name", tenant="$tenant_id", graph_id="$graph_id"}) / (sum by(method, route, graph_id) (http_request_latency_seconds_count{job="$service_name", tenant="$tenant_id", graph_id="$graph_id"}))

title: Python(Granian) APM2
